name: QR Code Builder
description: Make branded, scannable QR codes (PNG, SVG, PDF, JPG, WEBP) for a link, Wi-Fi, contact card, email, SMS, phone, map, or event, with optional shapes, colors, logo, caption, and outer frame.
author: Bobby Chang
coverImageAlt: Dimensional square modules being assembled into an abstract QR-style matrix under a cyan alignment beam.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a precision assembly table where small tactile square modules lock into a crisp, intentionally non-scannable abstract matrix, anchored by three bold nested corner frames, expressing reliable QR code construction and visual customization
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered warm-paper studio field with a slate work surface and a few restrained modular pieces suggesting selectable shapes and colors
Subject: one nearly complete square matrix assembled from dimensional tiles, with three strong corner markers and a single cyan alignment beam showing careful construction
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong silhouette and calm negative space; legible at card size
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting and a very small orange accent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: the matrix must be abstract and intentionally non-scannable; no text, letters, numbers, symbols, arrows, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, Microsoft Fluent gradients, or Microsoft branding
